prompt: glibc printf_info width precision star arginfo function value
answer:
For a glibc custom `printf` conversion:

| `printf_info` member | No `*` specified | `*` specified in `arginfo` | `*` specified in handler |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `prec` | `-1` | `INT_MIN` | Actual precision argument value |
| `width` | `0` | `INT_MIN` | Actual width argument value |

Thus, the `arginfo` function cannot know the actual width or precision when `*` is used; it receives `INT_MIN` for those fields. The handler receives the values retrieved from the argument list. The `arginfo` function should use its return value to specify how many arguments the conversion expects and fill `argtypes` with their types. (glibc manual: [Conversion Specifier Options](https://sourceware.org/glibc/manual/latest/html_node/Conversion-Specifier-Options.html), [Defining the Output Handler](https://sourceware.org/glibc/manual/latest/html_node/Defining-the-Output-Handler.html))
